name: std::source_location::function_name
intro: Returns the name of the function associated with the position represented by this object, if any.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
If this object represents a position in a body of a function, returns an implementation-defined null-terminated byte string corresponding to the name of the function.

Otherwise, an empty string is returned.
